1403.d: The Artisans' Workshop is a Smithing workshop founded by Aksel, located in the south-east corner of Falador.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Three times a day, players can use the modified blacksmith's helmet to teleport directly to the Artisans' Workshop.
• Teleport to the Mining Guild using the skills necklace, then go east.
• Teleport to the Mining Guild resource dungeon using the dungeoneering cape, climb up any of the 4 ladders, and go east.
• Teleport to the Falador Mole Lair using a boss portal attuned to the giant mole in War's Retreat, then go south-east.
• Teleport to Falador using the Lodestone Network or by casting Falador Teleport, then go south-east.
• Teleport to the southern Falador gate using a 'Chipped' Falador teleport created with Evil Dave's Spellbook, then go north-east to the workshop.
• Teleport to the Falador farm using the Explorer's ring 3 or 4 cabbage-port or South Falador Teleport, then go north-west into Falador, then east to the workshop.

1421.d: The Asgarnian Ice Dungeon is a moderately large dungeon in Asgarnia.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
When walking, go to Port Sarim and head south from the Port Sarim Jail, past a grove of willow trees. Go up the small hill and you will arrive at the trapdoor.

For faster transportation, players can use:
• A Dungeoneering cape (0,8) to instantly teleport right into the dungeon, just outside the resource dungeon's entrance.
• Fairy ring code AIQ , which goes to Mudskipper Point.
• A Home Teleport, to teleport to Port Sarim lodestone, which is located in the central Port Sarim.
• House Teleport, if the player has a player-owned house (members only) located in Rimmington.
• An Explorer's ring, which can teleport to the cabbage field north of Port Sarim.
• An amulet of glory, which can teleport to Draynor Village, the village east of Port Sarim.
• A skills necklace, which can teleport to the Crafting Guild north-west of Port Sarim.
• The Captain's log, which can teleport to the player-owned port portal. Then, just run south.

1471.d: The astral altar is a runecrafting altar located to the south-east of the village on Lunar Isle.
1471.ex: A mysterious power emanates from this shrine.

gt.heading: Access
gt.text:
Unlike most altars, the astral altar is not located within an extra-planar temple, and resides instead on the same plane of existence as Gielinor. As such, a talisman, talisman staff, tiara, or the wicked hood is not needed. Players should take caution for the suqah that are on the way to the altar.
• The fastest way to get there is to use the wicked hood's teleport, which can only be used twice, or three times if full wicked robe outfit has been purchased from the Wizard Finix's Runecrafting Shop. In order to use the wicked hood's teleport to the astral altar, players must have completed Lunar Diplomacy and also have fed an omni-talisman to the hood.
• The second fastest way is to break an astral altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
• The third fastest way is to use the Moonclan Teleport Lunar spell or to break a teleport tablet, either of which will take players next to the small obelisk north of the altar, right outside the Lunar Isle bank. This is the quickest method without access to wicked hood teleports.
• The fourth fastest way is by using the Lunar Isle lodestone.
• It's also possible to reach the astral altar using the astral rift in the Abyss after completing Lunar Diplomacy.

1481.d: The Asuran Arsenal is a heist area requiring level 108 Thieving to access.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The Asuran Arsenal can be found to the south-east of the Anachronia Swamp Fortress, on the far south-east shore of Anachronia. Players will first need to talk to Liara, who is standing just outside the vault entrance, to unlock it. Level 108 Thieving is required to enter. The requirement is not boostable.
• Teleport to Laniakea using the Slayer cape's perk and then run south down the stairs, then to the east.
• Orthen teleportation device to Xolo City can be unlocked by solving the mystery Teleport Node On.
• Teleport to Raksha, the Shadow Colossus using the combat portal or a boss portal, then exit the Orthen Oubliette and run south-east. Requires completion of the Raksha, the Shadow Colossus quest.
• Eastern Anachronia Teleport, or teleport to the Rex Matriarchs lair and exit the lair, then run south to reach the Fortress.
• Run far south-east from the Anachronia lodestone, preferably via Anachronia Agility Course. This route is very, very long and may be confusing to some due to Anachronia's non-linear paths, therefore it is not recommended unless all other options are unavailable.
